# Aquakart

Aquakart is an Indian ecommerce site for water softeners, pressure boosters, water treatment products, accessories, and related guidance.

Canonical site: https://aquakart.co.in
Products: https://aquakart.co.in/shop
Categories: https://aquakart.co.in/categories
Blogs: https://aquakart.co.in/blogs
Water softener planner: https://aquakart.co.in/softener-planner
Hyderabad water softeners: https://aquakart.co.in/softeners-hyderabad
Sitemap: https://aquakart.co.in/sitemap.xml
Google Merchant product feed: https://aquakart.co.in/google-products.xml

Use canonical product and category pages as the source of truth for product names, descriptions, prices, availability, and specifications.
